purpose: Editable Monroe-only planning assumptions for catalog rows without an existing general planning rule. Values are budget quantities, not approved takeoffs or purchase orders.

groups.basis: Undefined placeholder or unidentified product: zero is a planning placeholder until the scope and exact item are defined.
One shared tool or equipment set for the project; check existing crew inventory before procurement.
Four paint markers for layout and installation checks; confirm color and tip.
Two crew-use tools for parallel work; check existing inventory.
Four shared crew-use units for the project; check existing inventory.
Four consumable units for one project crew; confirm product pack and actual use.
Two chalk-line refills for one project crew; confirm pack size.
One assumed 50-mL tube per project as a starter allowance. No fire-pipe joint count or product use per joint is available; confirm actual need and system compatibility.
Budget 16 fluid OZ per project / one assumed 16-fluid-OZ container = 1 EA. Confirm actual use, compatible product and pack size.
One complete 100-ft hose per listed work stage as a planning allowance. Check site reach, diameter, pressure rating, connectors and whether the two stages can share one hose.
Four rigging units for one installation crew; lifting plan and certified capacities pending.
One large digger on site; schedule, availability and rental duration pending.
Two rental days for equipment handling; schedule and production rate pending.
One contingency pump only if trench water is encountered; conditional budget allowance.
One pile or bracket per linked U-saddle pile-cap position. The saddle family is model evidence, not a confirmed pile or bracket schedule; verify the foundation design.
Assume one extension at 25% of pile positions; depth and geotechnical design pending.
Catalog rule: two bedframe nuts or bolts per assumed pile position; verify the pile-to-bedframe connection schedule.
Two bedframe bolt pairs per assumed pile, with ten washers per pair (20 washers per pile); catalog allows a different washer count, so confirm detail.
Two FT threaded rod per modeled foundation HSS beam; connection lengths pending.
Two gap spacers per modeled foundation HSS beam; bearing layout pending.
Two fluid OZ cutting fluid per modeled HSS beam / assumed 16-fluid-OZ bottle = 0.125 bottle per beam; 29 beams require 58 fluid OZ, rounded up to 4 EA. Confirm drilling method and bottle size.
Crawl-space membrane proxy: first-story livable XY footprint x 1.10 for laps and upturns; confirm actual crawl coverage and membrane roll width.
Assume two floor-to-HSS connections per modeled foundation HSS beam and one threaded rod per connection.
Assume two floor-to-HSS connections per modeled foundation HSS beam and two washers or nuts per connection.
Eight floor connection screws per modeled 4 x 3 plate; verify which plates and fasteners are installed on site.
Assume cassette joints at 0.1875 FT per SQFT, 1/2-inch gap and 2-inch fill depth: SQFT x 0.1875 x 0.5 x 2 / 144 CUFT.
Four metal-to-metal screws per FT of modeled stud-wall run on each story; connection design pending.
One temporary brace per 10 FT of modeled stud wall on each story and four 4-inch screws per brace.
One 4 x 4 wall-angle connection per 8 FT of modeled stud wall on each story and two nuts per connection; angle schedule pending.
Two bolts per modeled Simpson/CF hold-down connection; verify bolt size and whether supplied with hardware.
One wall-to-wall plate per 8 FT of modeled stud wall on each story; joint layout pending.
Two bottom-track-to-floor screws per FT of modeled stud-wall run on each story.
Four replacement spray nozzles for project foam work; confirm compatibility.
Budget 16 fluid OZ foam-gun cleaner / one assumed 16-fluid-OZ can = 1 EA. Confirm product compatibility and actual application rate.

Assume site-applied cement board on 10% of one exterior stud-wall face, including garage-type exterior walls. Use modeled wall Area after openings for 38 walls and gross Length x height for the one wall with no Area. Factory-installed board is not deducted; confirm installation scope and avoid overlap with FIN-107 concrete board.
Assume two bearing connections per modeled truss and four truss screws per connection (eight per truss); structural fastening schedule pending. Roof-panel screws are a separate line.
Two angles or stitch pieces per linked model truss label; location and installation design pending.
Purlins at 2-FT spacing: roof SQFT / 2 FT = FT of purlin, before waste and edge details.

One SQFT slope material per SQFT modeled roof sheathing. The catalog places this item in Roof Panels > Slope Build-Up and names its input roof_slope_material_area, despite the floor-cassette product name. Confirm actual roof coverage and whether the slope is factory built.
1.5 roof-panel screws per SQFT proxy roof area; panel span and purlin schedule pending.
0.3 roof-panel rivets per SQFT proxy roof area; seam layout pending.
One FT seam tape per 3 SQFT proxy roof area; panel coverage width assumed 3 FT.

Truss-stage board fastener allowance: assume site-applied board on 10% of modeled roof-sheathing area and ten board-to-metal screws per board SQFT, equivalent to one screw per roof SQFT. Do not add the wall-board area from PAN-036; confirm truss board scope and fastening schedule.
Two 3/8-inch MC fittings per ordinary interior or exterior outlet position; high-amperage cable sizes excluded.
20 FT of catalog 10/3 MC cable per modeled 30-AMP outlet position; electrician must verify cable size and routing.
Two 1/2-inch fittings per modeled 30-AMP outlet position; conduit or cable termination method pending.
20 FT of catalog 8/3 MC cable per modeled 50-AMP outlet position; electrician must verify cable size and routing.
Two 3/4-inch fittings per modeled 50-AMP outlet position; conduit or cable termination method pending.
Two 12-AWG connectors per ordinary interior or exterior outlet position; circuit wiring pending.
Two 10-AWG connectors per modeled 30-AMP outlet position; 50-AMP connection product remains a separate specification decision.
Eight insulated lugs for project distribution equipment; terminal schedule pending.
One temporary test tee per modeled cold-water fixture proxy; testing plan pending.
Four pump connection fittings for a shared hydrotest setup.
One rough-in box per AC cover proxy; verify installed AC unit locations.
One component per modeled toilet; verify package inclusions.
Two mounting rods per modeled toilet; connection detail pending.
Two connection fittings per modeled toilet; verify fixture package.
One cover per modeled AeroPure or exhaust-only fan; confirm whether the fan already includes its cover.
One screen or operating-hardware set per modeled tilt-and-turn or hung window; four fixed windows excluded. Confirm screens and hardware supplied with units.
One shade per modeled wall-based window-shade assembly; reconcile with electrical shade controls before ordering.
One trim attachment per FT of model-derived installed window-trim run; clip or screw spacing pending.

Assume 20 FT routed material per modeled smart button or touch-panel position. These three catalog rows may specify different materials on the same route; circuit schedule and product distinction pending.
Two low-voltage terminations per modeled smart button or touch-panel position; connector specification pending.

Planning circuit proxy: one breaker per five standard outlets, one per modeled high-amp outlet and wall AC unit, one per ten lighting/fan positions, one each for water heater, battery and solar array. Circuit schedule, panel capacity and breakers included with panels must be checked.
One cable tie per 50 SQFT livable area as a rough electrical-routing allowance.
One SQFT garage-ceiling drywall per SQFT modeled GARAGE room area; no separate gypsum ceiling surface is modeled.
1.25 drywall screws per SQFT modeled GARAGE room area; garage ceiling attachment schedule pending.
One SQFT concrete board per assumed 2-FT-high finish band along exterior stud-wall length; this is a roof-edge/truss-finish proxy, not modeled board coverage. Reconcile PAN-036 wall CB.

Eight finish screws per SQFT of the same assumed truss-finish concrete-board band as FIN-107. Uses unrounded band area before quantity rounding; actual board layout, substrate and fastener schedule pending.
Four grinding discs for site floor preparation; substrate condition pending.
Sum typed Neovi_Length for face-based LED profiles and only wall-based runs without a near-identical 3D run; spatial duplicates are excluded. Confirm profile design and cut waste.
Four S-5 roof-panel clamps per modeled solar panel as a mounting proxy; engineered clamp schedule pending.
Monroe models all-in-one wall units and no branch box. Hold this at zero in the current-system scenario; if a split system is selected, budget one branch box per project.
Monroe models all-in-one wall units and no outdoor split equipment. Hold refrigerant lines at zero; if split units are specified, budget 30 FT per indoor unit.
Monroe models no outdoor unit-to-branch-box route. Hold at zero; if a split system is specified, budget 50 FT per project.
One solid-surface touch-up kit for project installation.
Ten abrasive sheets of this grit per sink or vanity work position as a solid-surface proxy; exact countertop area pending.
Treat 25% of dry-room floor area at 1 LB per SQFT; separate leveling products may describe alternate methods, so choose the actual assembly before ordering.
One layer over summed dry-room interior areas; garage, bath, WC, powder and laundry rooms are excluded. Verify room boundaries, floor finish schedule and waste.
Fifty hot-glue sticks as project installation consumables; actual task scope pending.
